name: Best Elf
source:
Best Elf is an erotic 2D visual novel spinoff of [url=/v21195]Faulty Apprentice[/url], following Eleanna and Zariinna. When an innocent competition between the two elves turns into a rescue mission, it's up to you and your friends to save the day! With two sexy elves and the world's greatest wizard at your side, what could go wrong?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1583240/]Steam[/url]]
